title: The Case and Its Joints
gist_ar: نص متخصص عن بناء الحجج: الحجة بتفشل عند المفصل، مش عند الدليل.
text:
An argument fails at its joints far more often than at its premises. This is
worth stating plainly, insofar as most training in critical reading concentrates
on evidence, whereas the errors that survive peer review are almost invariably
errors of connection.

Consider a structure common in policy writing. A premise is established;
evidence is presented; a conclusion follows, introduced by "thus" or "hence" or,
more ambitiously, "accordingly". The evidence may be impeccable. Nevertheless the
conjunction is doing work that has not been earned, in that it asserts a relation
the data do not contain. Correlation is reported and causation is inferred,
whereby a marker becomes a mechanism without anybody claiming that it is one.

Conversely, a genuinely cohesive argument can be recognised by a simple test.
Remove every discourse marker and read what remains. If the sequence still
compels, the markers were describing a structure that was there. If it collapses
into a list, they were supplying one that was not. Coherence, in other words, is
a property of the reasoning; cohesion is a property of the prose, and the second
is regularly mistaken for the first.

Notwithstanding this, moreover is not a crime. Furthermore, the practice of
signposting is what allows a reader to follow a long chain at all, and papers
stripped of it are measurably harder to use.

The rationale for attending to joints is therefore practical. Evidence can be
checked by anyone with the data. A connective cannot, which is why it is where a
weak case is most safely concealed, and why the reviewer who concedes the
evidence and interrogates the conjunction is the one who tends to refute
something.

questions.q: Where does the writer say arguments most often fail?
questions.q_ar: فين بتفشل الحجج أكتر حسب الكاتب؟

questions.q: What is the test for a genuinely cohesive argument?
options: Check the evidence against the raw data
Remove every marker and see whether the sequence still compels

questions.q: What distinction does the writer draw between coherence and cohesion?
questions.q_ar: إيه الفرق بين الترابط المنطقي والترابط اللغوي؟
options: Coherence belongs to the reasoning, cohesion to the prose

questions.q: Why is a connective the safest place to conceal a weak case?
questions.q_ar: ليه أداة الربط أأمن مكان لإخفاء حجة ضعيفة؟
options: It cannot be checked against data the way evidence can
